versions.name: Camp Sasakwa
versions.summary: A primitive Last Frontier Council camp along the Canadian River south of Holdenville, Oklahoma, a large forested tract used for low-impact wilderness and short-term unit camping where participants carry in their own supplies and water.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified via the Last Frontier Council (#480) registration portal, which schedules current Camp Sasakwa events, and ScoutWiki. The source labeled this an Indian Nations Council camp; it is a Last Frontier Council property. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (rural address did not geocode); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active status verified via the council's registration portal; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive short-term camping property; features unsurveyed; pin approximate.
